content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the AIIMS Delhi Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 11-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of AIIMS Delhi to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application along with CV and documents is 11 September 2026. Ensure you complete the process before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Associate posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the posts of Project Associate-I and Project Associate-II in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: For the Project Associate-I position, candidates need to have a Four years Bachelor's Degree or a Master's Degree in Psychology from a recognized university or its equivalent.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any experience required for Project Associate-II?
faq.answer: Yes, for the Project Associate-II post, in addition to the educational qualification, candidates must possess two years of experience in research.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for these positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the advertised posts is 50 years. Age relaxation details are not specified in the provided data.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: The salary for Project Associate-I ranges from Rs. 30,000 + 30% HRA (Rs. 39,000/- p.m.) to Rs. 37,000 + 30% HRA (Rs. 48,100/- p.m.).

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for Project Associate-II?
faq.answer: The salary for Project Associate-II ranges from Rs. 33,000 + 30% HRA (Rs. 42,900/- p.m.) to Rs. 42,000 + 30% HRA (Rs. 54,600/- p.m.).

faq.question: Q8. What is the application fee for AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Associate posts will involve an Interview and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for the AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online on or before the last date. You can use the 'Apply Online' link provided in the Important Links section or visit the official AIIMS Delhi website.
